body: Fireguard run 1 diagnosis (DM-198): the 174 graded files pass once in a manual committed-tree snapshot (git archive HEAD 99d7f4c, node_modules junction, VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2): 174 files / 3,487 tests passed in 176 s alone. With Fireguard's default 5 lanes (16 CPUs -> 2 workers each) running concurrently, a flake run exceeds testTimeoutMs 300000; the lane is killed with taskkill (asynchronous on Windows), fail-fast closes the lanes and rm of the snapshot hits a still-held directory (EBUSY), which replaces the result with a tool error. Run 2: same base/head and command with FIREGUARD_CONCURRENCY=2 (README speed knob; 5 workers per lane). No threshold, rule, timeout, config or fireguard source changed.
